title: Determiners
content: DefinitionEnglish: Determiners are words placed before a noun to indicate its quantity, extent, or specificity.Hindi: Determiner wo shabd hote hain jo noun ke pehle aate hain aur uski sankhya, parimaan, ya nirdharitata ko darshate hain.There are several types: Articles, Demonstratives, Possessives, Quantifiers, Distributives, Interrogatives, and others.Kayi prakar hote hain: Articles, Demonstratives, Possessives, Quantifiers, Distributives, Interrogatives, aur anya.Example: The book is on that table.Hindi: Woh kitaab us mez par hai.

title: Articles
content: DefinitionEnglish: Articles are determiners that specify whether a noun is definite or indefinite.Hindi: Articles wo determiners hote hain jo noun ko nirdharit (definite) ya anirdharit (indefinite) batate hain.TypesDefinite Article (The): Used for specific nouns — निश्चित संज्ञा के लिएIndefinite Articles (A/An): Used for non-specific nouns — अनिश्चित संज्ञा के लिएExample: I saw a cat. The cat was black.Hindi: Maine ek billi dekhi. Woh billi kaali thi.

title: Demonstratives
content: UseEnglish: Used to point to specific nouns based on their position or context (this, that, these, those).Hindi: Kisi vishesh noun ki taraf ishara karne ke liye (yeh, woh, in, un).StructureDemonstrative + NounExample: This pen is mine.Hindi: Yeh pen mera hai.

title: Possessives
content: UseEnglish: Show ownership of a noun (my, your, his, her, its, our, their).Hindi: Noun ke swaamitva ko darshate hain (mera, tumhara, uska, uski, iska, hamara, unka).StructurePossessive + NounExample: This is my book.Hindi: Yeh meri kitaab hai.

title: Quantifiers
content: UseEnglish: Indicate the quantity or number of a noun (some, any, many, few, a lot of, several, etc.).Hindi: Noun ki sankhya ya parimaan ko batate hain (kuch, koi, bahut, thoda, kaafi, kayi, aadi).StructureQuantifier + NounExample: I have many friends.Hindi: Mere bahut dost hain.

title: Distributives
content: UseEnglish: Refer to individual members of a group (each, every, either, neither).Hindi: Samooh ke vyaktiyon ko alag-alag darshate hain (har, pratyek, koi ek, na hi).StructureDistributive + NounExample: Each student received a prize.Hindi: Har vidyarthi ko ek inaam mila.

title: Interrogative Determiners
content: UseEnglish: Used to ask questions about nouns (which, what, whose).Hindi: Noun ke bare mein prashn puchhne ke liye (kaun sa, kya, kiska).StructureInterrogative + NounExample: Which book do you want?Hindi: Kaun si kitaab chahiye?

title: Numerals
content: UseEnglish: Indicate specific numbers or order of nouns (one, two, first, second, etc.).Hindi: Noun ki sankhya ya kram ko darshate hain (ek, do, pehla, doosra, aadi).StructureNumeral + NounExample: I bought two apples.Hindi: Maine do seb kharide.
